picks.why: NRG trades at 10.2x forward earnings with a 7% FCF yield and 24% revenue growth, the cheapest cash generator on the shortlist in an overweight segment the watchlist covers only through VST. It is a direct way to own power scarcity without SMR-style cash burn, and it led its segment over five days (+4.0%).
picks.risk: Power prices or capacity auctions soften as data-centre load forecasts get cut, and its debt from the LS Power deal weighs harder in a credit squeeze.

picks.why: Onto grows revenue 88% with a 23% operating margin yet trades at 14.8x forward earnings, 51% off its high, as advanced-packaging inspection rides AI chip demand. It tops the screen and diversifies the watchlist away from AMAT's front-end exposure.
picks.risk: A pause in CoWoS and HBM packaging capex after the SEC probe or financing stress would hit its order book quickly.
